'''Exar Kun A Major brute force crossing luke deck crossing Luke deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Exar Kun]]
* '''Published:''' 3 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 BHBM Kun DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A force draining, brute force, crossing Luke deck (NEED INPUT)

== Strategy ==

I use a combination of high power major destiny drawing and canceling their destinies to win battles and get cards under insignificant rebellion.  I also use the two naboo sites to force drain and for better battling when I face a space deck I get out my Vader ASAP and have them lose three force for your destiny.  This is an old deck I have improved and changed it much and it now has space.  I wanted to see how it would get rated
